dct_description_sm: California with flat northern coast, and place names Nova Albion, P S Franc[isco] Draco, C de Pinas, C de S Martin, C de Galera, Pueblo de la Cansas. Straet Anian and Anian to north. Great Lakes are missing. Partial outline of Zelandia Nova, Iapan, and Ieso are included. Title cartouche of simple draped cloth with shading behind (top left).
Original McLaughlin book number (1995 edition) with latest state information: 25-01
State 1: C de Fortuna labelled on mainland at 50 deg. N. Single ship vignette to west of California. Issued in his: Philippi Cluverii introductio in universam geographiam, Amsterdam, 1661.

State 2: With cartouche of draped cloth and branches above; with H. Mosting sculp.; C de Fortunas labelled on California; and a ship to west of California. Issued in: Philippi Cluverii introduction in omnem geographiam veterem æque ac novam ... / Johannis Bunonis, curante Johanne Reiskio. -- Lunæburg, MDCXCIV (1694).

State 3: With cartouche of draped cloth held by winged cherub; with Iohn Senex sculpt.; C Fortuna, P S F Drake, C S Martin among labelled places on California, and Fretum Anian and Anian to north. No ship vignette. Issued in his: Philippi Cluveri introductionis in universam geographiam, London, 1711.

State 4: With cartouche of draped cloth held by winged cherub, no engraver or cartographer named, C de S Fortunas labelled on California, and no ship vignette. Issued in his: Philippi Cluveri introductionis in universam geographiam, Amsterdam, 1729.ornia, and no ship vignette.
